meta.basis: github pavelya/match app/globals.css + live audit, 2 October 2026

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, inputs: the default raised surface on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: filter panels, quick-facts rows, table stripes.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill for neutral controls, skeletons, chips at rest.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Footer and dark bands. Pair with `fg-on-inverse`.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: university names, meta lines, hints. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text only; never for information that must be read.

tokens.name: fg-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines (decorative).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and selectable-tile outlines: 3:1 against `surface`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected states, focus ring. Text on `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tiles, active nav pill, info callouts.

tokens.name: primary-soft-fg
tokens.usage: Text on `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: The logo tile and large brand graphics only (not text).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Requirement met, strong match: text and icons on `surface`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success callouts and met-requirement rows.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Partly met, deadlines, data that needs checking: text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning callouts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Requirement not met, errors, destructive actions: text and icons.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error callouts and unmet-requirement rows.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter marker behind a key word in marketing headlines, and the 'Updated' badge. Always with `ink-900` text.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight`.

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero H1 only. 40px on phones to 64px on desktop. Fluid: clamp(2.5rem, 1.85rem + 2.6vw, 4rem).
styles.sample: Find programs that fit your IB Diploma

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing section headings (H2) and country-guide H1. Fluid: clamp(2rem, 1.6rem + 1.6vw, 3rem).
styles.sample: Study in the Netherlands with the IB Diploma

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: App page titles (H1): Search programs, Your matches, program name. Fluid: clamp(1.75rem, 1.55rem + 0.8vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section headings (H2) inside app pages and guides.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card titles in detail views, dialog titles (H3).
styles.sample: Why this is a strong match

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs on marketing pages and guides.
styles.sample: Enter your predicted grades once. We check HL and SL requirements for 1,273 programs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text, form values. Max line length 68ch.
styles.sample: Applicants need 37 points with HL 6 6 5, including Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text: university name, meta lines, hints, table cells.
styles.sample: University of Edinburgh · Edinburgh, United Kingdom

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, form labels, nav items, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, footnotes. Never the only place essential information appears.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above a heading. One per section, at most.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: Big numbers: match score, total IB points. Tabular figures.

styles.name: stat-md
styles.usage: Points requirement on program cards (IB 37+). Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps (icon to badge text).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and buttons; between label and input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related rows (meta lines in a card).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card padding on phones; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small tags, the grade buttons inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, program cards, callouts, dropdown panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, marketing feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, switches and the score ring only. Not buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons at rest (outline variants).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card hover, sticky bars, dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: Max width of app pages (search, matches, program detail).

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of marketing pages and the header.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of running text: descriptions, guides, legal pages (about 68 characters).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site and app header.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar, plus the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, chips and tab-bar items on touch screens.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky filter bar, sticky summary.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Header and bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialog, sheet.
